200193927.title: File:DSC 7749 Golden hour on the shore - a parent and child walk hand in hand as the sun sets over the tranquil sea.jpg

ObjectName.value: DSC 7749 Golden hour on the shore - a parent and child walk hand in hand as the sun sets over the tranquil sea

Categories.value: Ban Chang District|Files with coordinates missing SDC location of creation|Flickr images reviewed by FlickreviewR 2

ImageDescription.value: This serene photograph captures a golden hour scene along the shore in Ban Chang, Rayong Province, Thailand. The sun hangs low in the sky, casting a warm amber glow across the horizon and creating a shimmering reflection that stretches across the calm sea toward the beach. In the foreground, the silhouettes of a parent and child walk hand in hand along the wet sand, their figures softly outlined against the luminous water. Other beachgoers can be seen scattered farther down the shoreline, enjoying the tranquil evening. In the distance, a forested headland with buildings juts into the bay, while small boats dot the peaceful waters. The interplay of warm sunset hues and soft silhouettes creates an intimate, contemplative atmosphere that perfectly embodies the quiet beauty of a tropical evening by the sea.
